title: The record factory refuses to construct a record without code and category, and preserves the cause chain across nested wrappings
asA: developer wrapping a low-level exception into a higher-level record
iWant: TAC-1702's factory to refuse a construction without code or category and to preserve the wrapped cause chain across every level
soThat: every record has the minimum debug information and the chain of causes is intact when the record is emitted

acceptanceCriteria.description: createErrorRecord({code, category, message, cause, context}) refuses (throws a controlled error) when code is missing or blank OR category is missing or blank; the thrown error names the missing field.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a caller invoking the factory without code or without category
acceptanceCriteria.then: the factory throws with a message naming the missing field

acceptanceCriteria.description: A record whose cause is itself a record has both records' code, category and message reachable through record.cause.cause chain traversal.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a record wrapping a record wrapping a low-level exception
acceptanceCriteria.then: the emitted JSON carries the full cause chain in the same shape as the top-level record fields, nested under cause

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a call to `createErrorRecord({code, category, cause: <deeply-nested cause 5 levels deep>})`, the returned record's `record.cause.cause.cause.cause.cause` chain is fully traversable and each level preserves its own `code`, `category` and `message`; the factory does NOT truncate the chain at an arbitrary depth (or if it does, the truncation is documented on the factory's contract as a maximum depth constant).
acceptanceCriteria.given: createErrorRecord called with a 5-level nested cause chain
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack traverses the cause chain
acceptanceCriteria.then: each level preserves its own code, category and message; the chain is either fully traversable or truncation is documented on the factory's contract

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given `createErrorRecord({code, category, cause: <cause carrying its own context field with redactable fields>})`, the redaction pass applies to the cause's `context` at every level of the chain (not only the top-level record); a record whose top-level context is redacted but whose cause.context leaks PII fails the pack check.
acceptanceCriteria.given: createErrorRecord with a cause carrying its own context with redactable fields
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the returned record's cause chain
acceptanceCriteria.then: the redaction pass has applied to every level's context; unredacted cause context fails

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given `createErrorRecord({code, category, cause: null})`, the returned record has `record.cause === null` (not undefined, not omitted); a record whose cause is undefined when the caller passed null fails the pack check because it breaks the schema contract on ADR-1701.
acceptanceCriteria.given: createErrorRecord called with cause explicitly null
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the returned record
acceptanceCriteria.then: record.cause is exactly null (not undefined, not omitted)
